run_detic_detection: run the Detic detection script on live robot head camera images with custom object categories
test_custom_categories: test Detic segmentation on a live image by passing custom categories via the --category CLI option
create_detic_perception: create a DeticPerception instance with a custom vocabulary and GPU ID for semantic segmentation
build_observations: build an Observations object from robot head camera RGB, depth, and XYZ image data
review_main: review the main CLI entry point that captures robot images and runs Detic semantic segmentation
